# bugs #3409: --peep-asm deletes an inline assembler label that only another function references

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3409/
- Category: [No action recommended](../../no-action.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Close. The manual documents both the label restriction and the effect of --peep-asm.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

The ticket's case behaves on r17193 as the reporter describes. For z80 it links without
`--peep-asm`, and with `--peep-asm` the linker reports `l_neg_l` as an undefined global. For the
same construct written for mcs51, the linker reports the undefined global with `--peep-asm` in the
small and large models.

Three results are from r17176 and were not repeated on r17193. The mcs51 program links without
`--peep-asm`, it does not link with `--peep-asm --stack-auto`, and with `-mstm8 --peep-asm` the
label is absent from the `.asm` file.

## Reason

With `--peep-asm` the peephole optimizer matches the lines of inline assembler against its rules.
One rule in each port deletes the labels that have a reference count of 0. It is `Peephole 500` in
`src/mcs51/peeph.def`, `common peephole 159` in `src/z80/peeph.def`, and `j30` in
`src/stm8/peeph.def`. `buildLabelRefCountHash` in `src/SDCCpeeph.c` counts references among the
lines of one function and exempts only the entry label of the function. A label that only another
function references therefore has a count of 0.

Two sections of the manual apply. The description of `--peep-asm` in "Optimization Options" says
that the option can change inline assembler in unexpected ways and tells the user to read the rules
in `peeph.def` first. "Use of Labels within Inline Assembler" allows only labels of the local form
`nnnnn$` in inline assembler, and references to them only inside the function. The first comment of
the ticket gives three alternatives, and the reporter accepted them.

The third comment gives a workaround, the global label definition `l_neg_l::`. Each of the three
rules has the pattern `%1:`. `matchLine` in `src/SDCCpeeph.c` does not match lines that have
characters left after the pattern, and for `l_neg_l::` the second colon is left. On r17193 with
`--peep-asm`, the ticket's case with `l_neg_l::` links for z80, and with `-mstm8 -S` the label is
in the `.asm` file. The mcs51 version with `l_neg_l::` and `--peep-asm` links and gives the correct
result in ucsim in the small and large models and with `--stack-auto`. The manual section on labels
does not allow the global form.

Three other programs were tested on r17176. Each was compiled for mcs51 with and without
`--peep-asm` and run in ucsim, and each gave the correct result with both settings. The first uses
the labels `00001$` and `00002$` inside one `__naked` function. The second follows the alternative
of the first comment in which the `__naked` function has the name `l_neg_l` and the other function
jumps to `_l_neg_l`. The z80 version of that program links with `--peep-asm`. The third defines a
label of the non-local form and references it inside its own function.
